summary: Scoped regression executed for reported /ai-consulting submission failure and base dropdown/consent changes. Backend public-form submissions are fixed for the email/company_email duplicate guard path (no 500 reproduced). Browser automation could not complete a full successful submit due blocking dropdown/interaction behavior in timeline/budget section.

ui_bugs.issue: Keyboard/typeahead selection flow leaves dropdown state inconsistent (stage menu remained open and timeline stayed unselected), preventing clean progression to submit.
Checkbox interaction became unreliable during open-dropdown state; automation observed check action not changing state and submit path blocked.

integration_issues.issue: Could not reach success state in three attempts because form remained invalid after dropdown interactions; therefore one-POST/double-click and one-row persistence could not be proven through browser path.

issues: Consent copy desktop line-height and inline wording target passed in first run; mobile/extra-width overflow and privacy-link navigation checks are pending because full script terminated early when submit path blocked.

action_items: Fix base dropdown keyboard interaction so Enter/typeahead reliably selects and closes menus for stage/timeline.
Fix consent checkbox interaction robustness when dropdown portals are active/open.
After UI fix, rerun mandatory real-browser proof: successful submit banner, receipt, disabled controls, exactly one POST on double-click, and one persisted row verification.
Code review: options.js currently forces en/em dashes to hyphens in optionLabel; this conflicts with requirement to preserve canonical display punctuation.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py duplicate guard calls now use company_email at three target endpoints and passed live proof-token API regression (contact/consultation/consulting) without 500.
frontend/src/pages/ai-consulting/options.js optionLabel replaces en/em dashes with hyphen (`replace(/[–—]/g, '-')`), likely violating requested canonical display text behavior.
Several older backend tests still assume deprecated Bearer-token admin login response; keep future auth tests aligned to cookie+CSRF flow from /api/admin/session + /api/admin/login.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (partial checks only; mandatory submit proof blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA records via public API for three endpoints using unique emails; cleaned via pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used public URL from frontend/.env. Backend regression test includes required form-context token flow and validates 201/200 success + duplicate 409 + DB persistence for /api/contact-enquiries, /api/ai-consultation-enquiries, /api/ai-consulting-enquiries. Playwright attempts (3) hit UI blocker in base dropdown/consent interaction before successful submit verification. Screenshot evidence in /app/test_reports/screenshots_iter36/.
rca of the issue: Reported backend KeyError class issue appears resolved: live API paths no longer throw 500 and persist correctly with company_email. Remaining blocker is frontend interaction sequencing in new dropdown/checkbox flow; stage/timeline keyboard handling left form invalid and interfered with consent/submission completion in automation.
